name: TupperDMX Smoke Machine
notes: Transcribed from TupperDMX's OFL file fixtures/smoke-machine.json, 1ch mode. busk has no fog attribute, so Fog Output is the intensity: a playback's level is the fog amount (DMX 0-7 is no fog), and the grand master and blackout apply to it. The 2ch mode (fog/haze type) is not transcribed.
